voice.name: Open Sector - Pelican
voice.description: Male transport flying-boat pilot in his mid-forties, easygoing and good-humored, warm mellow chuckling voice over the radio with a relaxed coastal accent, unhurried like a bus driver on a sunny route, a friendly uncle figure who treats every delivery as a pleasant day trip.
voice.sample: Afternoon, everybody! Big bird's coming in low and slow, all six engines purring like kittens. Got your crate, got your paratroopers, even got a thermos of coffee. Where would you like it dropped?

move.prompt: Huge four-engined turboprop flying boat flying overhead, deep heavy droning of turboprop engines with slow doppler fly-by, outdoors, no music, no voice

special.prompt: Aircraft cargo bay doors opening with hydraulic whine and rushing wind, crate released, parachutes snapping open and fluttering, engine drone in background, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Large multi-engine flying boat crashing into the sea, engines failing, heavy impact on water with a huge splash, explosion and metal breaking apart, no music, no voice
